name: Increase Minimum CPU State
description: Raises the minimum CPU power state to prevent aggressive clock-downs during light tasks, improving responsiveness on desktop systems. This may increase power usage and fan noise.

description_i18n.en: Raises the minimum CPU power state to prevent aggressive clock-downs during light tasks, improving responsiveness on desktop systems. This may increase power usage and fan noise.
description_i18n.de: Erhöht den minimalen CPU-Leistungszustand, um aggressives Heruntertakten bei leichten Aufgaben zu vermeiden und die Reaktionsfähigkeit auf Desktop-Systemen zu verbessern. Dies kann den Stromverbrauch und Lüftergeräusche erhöhen.
description_i18n.fr: Augmente l'état minimal de performance du processeur pour éviter une baisse de fréquence agressive lors des tâches légères, améliorant la réactivité sur les PC fixes. Cela peut augmenter la consommation d'énergie et le bruit des ventilateurs.

warnings.title: Power consumption increase
warnings.message: The system may consume more power, run hotter, or produce louder fan noise because the processor maintains a higher clock speed during idle periods

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the processor power settings via the Windows Power Configuration tool (powercfg) by setting a specific index value for minimum CPU state in both AC and DC schemes
